notes.title: Stormbound March Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Stormbounders! A new version of Stormbound is coming in March, bringing new balance changes, new in-game event, new card and new brawl modifier!


St. Patrick's Event
Celebrate Saint Patrick’s Day in Stormbound! From March 17th to March 24th, 2025 (8:00 AM CET), enjoy festive surprises, special rewards, and more!

Event Gift
During the event, everyone will receive a gift of coin 200 coins. To grab the gift, just redeem a special code, which is valid from March 17th to March 24th, 2025 (8:00 AM CET).

Gift code: CLOVER
[olist] To activate the code, go to the redeem code site.
 Enter the code in the Code field.
 Enter your Player ID in the Player ID field (you can find your Player ID in the in-game settings and copy it from there).
 Click the Redeem Code button.[/olist]

More Coins
During the event, all coin gains and the coin cap will be doubled, except for quests. The daily coin cap will be set at 1,000 coins for free-to-play players, and 2,000 coins for players with a premium pass.

More Cards
Book of Elders and Book of Toads will yield 2 extra cards for the duration of the whole event in store, starting from March 17th to March 24th, 2025, 8:00 AM CET.


Wildlife Event
Spring is in the air, so let’s celebrate wildlife with our special in-game event!

From March 4th to March 10th, 2025 (ending at 8:00 AM CET), enjoy exclusive bonuses created just for this occasion!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32724087/0f8ed20cc100dba4d0f1e2db3a6fb07d9e930f75.png

Event Gift
During the event, everyone will receive a gift of 200 coins. To grab the gift, just redeem a special code, which is valid from March 4th to March 10th, 2025, 8:00 AM CET.

Gift code: WILDLIFE
[olist]
 To activate the code, go to the redeem code site.  
 Enter the code in the Code field.
 Enter your Player ID in the Player ID field (you can find your Player ID in the in-game settings and copy it from there).
 Click the Redeem Code button.
[/olist]

Note: You can only redeem this code from March 4th 2025, until March 10th, 2025 (8:00 AM CET). If you experience any problems with activating the code, please contact @Aileen on Discord or email contact@stormboundgames.com for assistance.

More Cards
Book of Ravens and Book of Satyrs will yield 2 extra cards for the duration of the whole event in store, starting from March 4th until March 10th, 2025 (8:00 AM CET).


Ruby Bonus
Moreover, every Ruby bundle will yield double the original number of rubies. This is not time-bound, and effectively lasts forever until every bundle has been bought once.


New Card
We’re excited to bring you a brand-new Primal card: Terrifying Behemoths!

This card will be available starting March 6th, 2025. Don’t miss your chance to add it to your collection!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32724087/ebf0369bbdf48e0824db69d5be547bde34cebd1b.png


New Brawl
A new Brawl modifier is launching on March 6th, 2025, featuring the new Terrifying Behemoths card.

This modifier lets you experiment with and enjoy the card before deciding whether to add it to your collection.

In this Brawl, a 0-mana, level 1 version of the new card will automatically be added to everyone’s deck, regardless of ownership or upgrades.

This means all decks will temporarily contain 13 cards, giving you an exciting opportunity to explore new strategies with new Primal.

Balance Changes
This release, just like any other, will bring some balance changes.

  Archdruid Earyn now costs 6 mana (down from 7), and the strength is now 6/7/8/9/11 (changed from 8/9/10/11/13)
 Prime Oracle Bragda's strength is now 5/6/7/9/11 (down from 6/7/8/10/12)
 Wolfcloaks' strength is now 9/10/11/12/14 (changed from 7/8/9/11/13)
 Rockworkers' strength is now 4/5/6/7/8 (up from 3/4/5/6/7), and its ability now builds a 5/6/7/8/9 strength Fort (now matching Ebonrock's values)
 Draconic Roamers' strength is now 2/3/4/5/6 (up from 2/3/3/4/4), and its ability now spawns a 2/2/2/2/2 strength Dragon (down from 2/2/3/3/4).
  Nerf compensation
 As usual, some compensation in the form of coins and fusion stones will be provided to owners of Prime Oracle Bragda, proportional to the level and rarity of the card. Find below the compensation values for each rarity and level. 

Community Programs
Don't forget about our Community Programs  launched in February!

These special in-game initiatives reward you for growing the Stormbound community while offering substantial benefits for both you and your Friends who are new to the game.

Whether you're a regular Player looking to invite Friends or a Content Creator eager to share Stormbound with your audience, these programs offer great benefits for both you and those you invite!


 Referral System – Available to all Players, this system allows you to invite new players to Stormbound and earn various rewards together. Both you and your Friends who are new to the game will gain in-game benefits when they join using your referral.
 Content Creator Program – If you're a content creator, you can promote Stormbound using a special referral code linked to your nickname. This helps grow the community while offering exclusive perks for you and your audience.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32724087/bcd20e9d793628fbdb42558931801ed284080ea5.png

Find all details about rewards, creating referral codes, and joining the Content Creator Program in the Community Programs tab. 

FAQ
What is the timeline of March's Update?


 The season reset and balance change: March 1st, 2025, 8:00 AM CET
 Wildlife Event duration: March 4th - March 10th, 2025, 8:00 AM CET
 Terrifying Behemoths release: March 6th, 2025, 8:00 AM CET
 Terrifying Behemoths Brawl: March 6th, 2025, 8:00 AM CET


-------------------

Feel free to drop by our Discord server to discuss the content of the upcoming update with us, the devs, and the community! 

Happy Stormbounding!

Ranked Mode
This update also introduces tweaks and changes to Ranked Mode, including the addition of a Friends Leaderboard.

Friends Leaderboard
We’re introducing the Friends Leaderboard, a new feature that adds a fun, competitive element to the game.

Friends Leaderboard 

This leaderboard shows your friends’ positions in each league, allowing you to track progress, celebrate victories, and challenge each other to climb higher. It’s the perfect way to connect and share the joy of competition.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32724087/b3dcbf45bccfcf02dce647ed7ee3691e94f6609c.png

Ranked Mode Changes
We’re introducing a small change to how you can unlock playing in a lower league: it will now cost 1 Ticket Card.

But why are we making this change?
Our recent rework of Ranked Mode, known as Ranked 3.0, brought significant improvements to gameplay but also had an unintended impact on the game’s economy. To address this and ensure a healthy and sustainable economy balance, we are introducing a small tweak.

Players will still be able to compete in any unlocked league below their current top rank and claim rewards (e.g., in Diamond if they’ve already advanced to HL this season). However, unlocking a lower league within the same season will now require spending 1 Ticket Card.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32724087/adbfc1fa4387ed3ae5e4bfe7592beeb067496655.png

We understand this change may feel unexpected, but it’s a necessary step to protect the game’s long-term economy balance. Our development team carefully considered this adjustment, prioritizing the overall fairness and enjoyment of Ranked Mode.

We appreciate your understanding and support as we make this change.

notes.title: Stormbound October Update
notes.notes:
Hello Stormbounders! 

A new version of Stormbound is coming in October, bringing balance changes, Ranked System Reword, and Halloween Event!

Ranked Mode Rework
In this update, we've reworked the Ranked Mode. Together with the new Fortress Leveling System and recent economy improvements, these updates aim to create a more balanced and rewarding experience for all players.

From now on, players will be able to play not only in their highest League, but also in all unlocked previous ones. Additionally, once Rank 1 of a league is maxed, you can still play in that rank just for coin winnings.

https://cdn.sanity.io/images/5hlpazgd/production/9fa9e55d4a94b1d5d2d740d3b976adad6175dc65-1500x1100.png?fit=max&auto=format&q=90


Seasonal Chests
Starting from now on, chests are given when you reach all stars in Rank 1 of a league, or at the end of the season for your highest league. When you reach Rank 1 in any league, you’ll get a chest right away and be promoted to the next league. This means no more waiting for the end of the month to claim rewards!

The only exception is the Heroes League Seasonal Chest - it is still only available at the end of the season.

https://cdn.sanity.io/images/5hlpazgd/production/ab850a34ed89467103b85c08ea54c1236a483297-800x800.png?fit=max&auto=format&q=90


Rewards
While individual chest rewards have been adjusted, the ability to collect more chests means you’ll be earning similar or more rewards for the same gameplay throughout the season.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32724087/e5f438589d650629da9346be124a46a2a52441dc.png

Fortress Level Exp doesn't change, which means there's now an additional way of getting more Exp - by unlocking lower level Seasonal Chests.

Fortress Level Exp doesn't change, which means there's now an additional way of getting more Exp - by unlocking lower level Seasonal Chests.

Heroes League Changes
In this update, we’ve removed the Diamond+ League and expanded the Heroes League to accommodate more than 500 players. This makes high-level competition more dynamic and ensures that top-ranked players have even more opportunities to compete at the highest levels.

Additional rewards which are given for ending in Top 250 or higher stay the same.

Please note that when Heroes League players decide to play in the Diamond League, their Heroes League score will not change.

Platinum League Change
We’ve added a card level limit of 4 in the Platinum League, making matches even more about skill and strategy inside it.

Matchmaking and Manual Relegation
Matchmaking has been adjusted to fit the current system, and don't worry! It will never prioritize matching new players with more experienced players.

We believe we did a good job with it, but based on results, we plan to keep tweaking it in the next weeks.


UI/UX Tweaks

BALANCE CHANGES

* All balance changes will be implemented on June 1, 2024. However, the update for Gift of the Wise will be rolled out separately with the client update in mid-June, along with the corresponding compensation.


NEW FORTRESS LEVELING SYSTEM

With the latest patch, we've reworked the Fortress Leveling system to grant experience points (EXP) for various in-game activities, rather than just collecting and leveling cards.

This system allows players to gain EXP by engaging in different activities, ultimately increasing their Fortress HP as they accumulate the required amount of EXP.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32724087/8a45c38b7a01789a6c6440f676c98f6cc96eb473.png

What's more, with the launch of the new Fortress Leveling System, we are removing the Base Demolisher system. Each player will receive an extra bonus reward from the Base Demolisher level they were on the verge of reaching.

EXP SOURCES
In-game activities that award experience points are divided into one-time and recurring categories.

One-time EXP Sources: These activities grant EXP only once per account:
  Finishing Campaign chapters.
 Reaching new highest rank for the first time.
 Unlocking a new card not yet in Player's collection. 


Recurring EXP Sources: These activities grant EXP each time the conditions are met:
 Dealing damage to the enemy base in competitive modes.
 Completing daily quests at each tier.
 Opening draft chests.
 Reaching brawl milestones.
 Opening ranked chests.
 Fortress Leveling System EXP Sources 


Rewards
The Fortress Leveling system also introduces intermediate levels that players can achieve between main fortress levels. Reaching these levels allows players to collect rewards.

Please refer to the table below for details on the EXP required to achieve levels and unlock rewards within the Fortress Leveling System, as well as the corresponding Fortress Levels themselves.

We're granting ourselves the flexibility to fine-tune the EXP values for individual activities as we gather more data. Nevertheless, at present, we're satisfied with the numbers we've implemented.

Additionally, we are planning new iterations of the system for players who have already completed 20 levels of the base game. However, we need to collect sufficient data before proceeding to ensure it is well-tailored to their needs.

Progress
What's more, players can view their Fortress level and progress toward the next level on the Player Profile popup, which features a progress bar. The popup includes a scrollable list of in-game activities and the EXP earned from each activity.

To sum up, this system is designed to offer players a higher-quality and fairer progression curve that more effectively rewards active play.

Ultimately, New Fortress Leveling provides significantly more resources for player progression through Fortress Levels compared to the Base Demolisher.

In that Brawl only, friendly Spooky Pumpkin spawn as enemy units die.

Because all friendly Spooky Pumpkins end up being destroyed to deal damage to the enemy base, only the first one can use its ability. When it activates, all the others are destroyed.

NEW LOGIN BETA
The new login system is nearly ready for release on both Android and iOS. All we need are some additional tests to ensure that everything works as expected. This gives you the opportunity to sign up and be one of the first players to try the new system and earn 50 rubies!

If you are interested in participating, here is what you need to do. Send an email to new.login.beta@stormboundgames.com with the following information:

 Your Stormbound player ID (e.g. 102390249)
 Your Discord  name + tag (e.g. Kitty#1909)
 Your country of residency (e.g. United States of America)
 The platform you play on (i.e. iOS or Android)
 The email you will be using to sign in with Google or Apple

It is important the subject of the email you send matches this very format:    login. For instance, Kitty#1909 1002216742 Android login.

From there, a handful of players will be chosen and invited to a private Discord channel mid-July to participate in the beta. All instructions will be given in due time.

DRAWING MECHANICS
Players have frequently reported that there might be a problem with the drawing mechanics, that makes getting back cards that were just played too often. After thorough testing, we’ve found out that this mechanic is working as expected.

For clarity: a card can be played more than once within the same turn, albeit rather rare. When a card is played, it goes back into the deck with a “weight” of 1. Another draw will cause a reweighing of the deck, which makes the card’s weight non null. From there, a subsequent draw (through card ability or cycling) can cause the card to be drawn (and played) again, even though the odds are not in favor.

Playing a few cards (and additionally cycling a card) in a turn causes a few draws at the end of the turn, therefore, with every draw, all cards in a deck are shuffled with new weights. Collector Mirz for example, creates a card with a weight of 1.

Note that cards generated by Guardi the Lightbringer used their own custom weighted draw algorithm. It will now be tuned down with the Balance Changes update on 2nd of November.

The logic of drawing mechanics goes more or less like this:

[olist]
 The deck is initially shuffled. This is to make sure the weights do not match the card order (lowest weight on cheaper cards, and higher weights on more expensive ones).
 The first card of the shuffled deck is assigned a weight of 1.
 Every card is then assigned a weight based on the weight of the previous card following the formula: weight × 1.6 + 100. As a result, the second card has a weight of 101.6 (1 × 1.6 + 100) and the third card of 262.56 (101.6 × 1.6 + 100) and so on and so forth.
 From there, 4 cards are drawn with the weighted random to compose the initial hand. That means the cards with the highest weights are most likely to be drawn, but that’s not a guarantee.
[/olist]

FAQ
When is the update going to be released?

The balance changes will be released with the season reset as usual, although on November 2nd due to the holiday. The 2 cards will be introduced on November 4th for Cursed Cemetery and November 11th for Frontline Engineers.

The Halloween event will extend from October 27th to November 6th (8AM CET) and the Black Friday event will extend from November 24th to November 28th (8AM CET).

How does the Spooky Pumpkin ability work?

In that Brawl-only, friendly Spooky Pumpkin spawn as enemy units die.

At the start of a turn, the first friendly Spooky Pumpkin on the board checks if there are at least 3 of them, and if there are, trigger its explosive ability.

Because all friendly Spooky Pumpkins end up being destroyed to deal damage to the enemy base, only the first one can use its ability. When it activates, all the others are destroyed.

What’s worth pointing out is that it possible to deal more than 3 damage to the base. Killing many units in one turn, and therefore spawning as many pumpkins, may result in explosive damage!

 The Warrior Brawl starting on October 13th will be for Obelisk of Souls.

HEROES LEAGUE

Top 500

The Heroes League is now limited to 500 players at any given time. To get into that league, players need to reach a higher peak score than the other players, or be one of the first 500 persons to reach the league.

If a player reaches all ranks and stars in the Diamond League, there are two scenarios that can happen:

[olist]
 If there are less 500 players in the Heroes League, the player automatically gets in.
 Otherwise, the player stays in the Diamond League. From that point onward, they will see information about their current and peak scores and how high they need to reach to get in the Heroes League.
[/olist]
Rewards in Heroes League

The Heroes League rewards (seasonal chest and special rewards based on the Hero score) are given differently than rewards in other leagues.


 Avatar: The top player in the Heroes League gets a unique avatar (just as before).
 Heroes Chest: The Heroes chest is given to all 500 members of the league, no matter which position they end the season at. However, players who were kicked out of the Heroes League cannot claim the Heroes chest; they get the Diamond chest.
 Books & Fusion Stones: The rewards in each Top List are given to all Heroes League members who end the season in this top list or higher. For instance, a player ending the season #96 collects additional rewards from the Top 100 and also from the Top 250.

 Top 1: 100 Fusion Stones
 Top 10: 50 Fusion Stones
 Top 100: 30 Fusion Stones
 Top 250: 20 Fusion Stones

The daily calendar which has been around for well over a year now will be revamped to add new mechanics.

Instead of one reward per day, the new calendar will have 15 gifts in total (regardless of which month).
Collecting a reward unlocks the next one, but there is a 24-hour cooldown period between collects. That means you don’t have to collect a certain reward on a specific day per se — you will be able to collect it whenever, provided you are not within your 24 hours cooldown period.

Premium Pass holders will still get an additional reward with every gift (collected at once like before). Buying a Premium Pass throughout the month will automatically grant the additional reward for all previously collected gifts, so nothing is lost.

Additionally, and perhaps more importantly, the Premium Pass is now a 30-days buy that’s not tied to the current calendar month. This means if one buys the Premium Pass on the 12th at 1pm, they will be a holder for exactly 30 days (ending at 1pm).

FAQ

When is the update going to be released?

The balance changes will be released with the season reset as usual. The 2 cards will be introduced on October 7th for Cheesy Lurers and October 14th for Obelisk of Souls. The Heroes League update will be effective as of October 1st.

I recently undertook going through all card abilities to improve their English version in an effort to make them more consistent and readable. I then pitched it to our development team to bring these changes to the game itself, which has been accepted.

These changes will be slowly rolled out in all languages in the next few months. Please be patient and it takes a significant amount of time to apply such transversal changes in so many languages.

In the meantime, here are the newly defined guidelines for English content on both Stormbound and Stormbound-Kitty.

Locale


 Stormbound uses American English over British English. There are subtle differences between the two languages. The most relevant ones for our project are:
 Words with an ending similar to “vitalize” are spelled with a “z”.
 Words with an ending similar to “defense” are spelled with a “s”.
 Words with an ending similar to “color” are spelled without a “u”.
 The word “canceled” is spelled with a single ”l”.


Capitalization


 Unit types (e.g. Feline) and modifiers (i.e. Ancient, Hero and Elder) should be capitalized.


Card abilities


 An ability should never end with a full stop, no matter whether it is made of several sentences.
 The word “all” should be omitted when possible as it is implied.
 The term “on the board” should be omitted as it is implied.
 The term “to fight for x” should be omitted as it is implied.
 The term “itself” should be preferred over “this”.
 The term “Before attacking” should be preferred over “When attacking”.


Pluralization


 The words “damage” and “strength” are never pluralized.


Highlighting


 Main actions should be highlighted (i.e. “build”, “command”, “confuse”, “convert”, “deal”, “deconfuse”, “decrease”, “destroy”, “disable”, “drain”, “draw”, “explode”, “fly”, “force”, “freeze”, “gain”, “give”, “increase”, “jump”, “move”, “play”, “poison”, “pull”, “push”, “remember”, “remove”, “restore”, “return”, “set”, “spawn”, “spend”, “split”, “teleport”, “trigger”, “vitalize”).
 Amounts (whether variadic or not) should be highlighted with their unit (e.g. “1/2/3/4/5 strength”, “1 unit”, “1/2/3/4/5 damage”, etc.).
 The words “bordering" and “surrounding” should be highlighted.

Kind thanks to DVRP#5076 for their ground work in their SBLocPatcher repository. A significant amount of the implemented changes were suggested by them.

DRAFT MODE

The draft mode is finally here! There is a lot to explain, so we’re going to do that bit by bit, so it’s digestible.

[olist]
 Synopsis
 Terminology
 How to enter
 Rewards
 Matchmaking
 Drafting a deck
 Leveling up cards
 Replacing cards
[/olist]
Synopsis
In a nutshell, the draft mode is an event where players compete in a series of matches with a unique deck that gets “drafted” specifically for the event. Cards may get swapped or upgraded after every match, leading to previously unseen decks and hopefully some different strategies from your typical ladder gameplay.

The draft runs weekly from Monday to Wednesday (therefore without overlap with the Brawl). Each player is able to play up to 3 draft “sessions” in order to get rewards during that timeframe. After which, it is still possible to play draft mode until the event ends, but without rewards — just for fun (while still earning coins for victories, as usual).

A session ends when the player wins 6 matches or loses 3 times, which ever comes first, leading to sessions lasting between 3 and 8 matches.

Terminology


 Session: A series of up to 8 matches ending with the player having lost 3 times, or the player having won 6 matches, based on the same drafted deck.
 Entry card: A special resource enabling the player to start a draft session.

How to enter
Only players with at least 11 base health can participate in the draft mode.

A draft session costs 1 “entry card”. Entry cards are special resources which are necessary to start a draft session. A player can have a maximum of 3 entry cards at a given time — that’s the upper cap for that resource. Entry cards can be obtained the following ways:


 An entry card can be collected freely once a week by watching an ad in the card shop tab.
 Entry cards can be bought for a few dollars. One entry card + 100 coins costs $2.99, two entry cards + 300 coins for $4.99.
 An entry card can be skipped altogether by paying 600 coins to start a draft session.


Rewards
The content of the chest retrieved at the end of a draft session depends on how many matches the player won, between 0 and 6 (as well as whether or not they own the Premium Pass). Here is the content of the 7 different chests:

Rewards	

0 wins - 2 common cards + 1 rare card
1 win - 3 common cards + 2 rare cards + 1 epic card + 1 fusion stone
2 wins - 4 rare cards + 2 epic cards + 2 fusion stones
3 wins - 4 rare cards + 2 epic cards + 3 fusion stones + 150 coins	
4 wins - 4 epic cards + 2 legendary cards + 4 fusion stones	
5 wins - 5 epic cards + 2 legendary cards + 5 fusion stones + 250 coins
6 wins - 4 epic cards + 3 legendary cards + 6 fusion stones + 600 coins	

Premium Pass extras

0 wins - 50 coins + 1 fusion stone
1 win -   100 coins + 1 fusion stone
2 wins - 100 coins + 1 fusion stone
3 wins - 100 coins + 1 fusion stone + 1 epic card
4 wins - 150 coins + 1 fusion stone + 1 epic card
5 wins - 250 coins + 2 fusion stones + 1 legendary card
6 wins - 400 coins + 3 fusion stones + 1 legendary card

Additionally, it is worth noting that victories will yield 10 coins + an additional 10 coins for watching an ad or for having the Premium Pass, regardless of the league of the player.

Matchmaking
Players are matched based on the amount of battles they have done within their session. So players having fought 1 time will be matched with other players having fought only 1 match so far.

The pools widen for higher number of matches to make sure players can find opponents: so players played 5, 6 or 7 times are all in the same matchmaking pool.

This is important because the base health grows throughout matches (regardless of their outcome). All players start at 10 base health, and every match increases it by 1. This means the base health can never go above 17 (for the last match).

Drafting a deck
Drafting a deck is done at the beginning of the draft session and consists of picking a total of 12 cards, each time from a set of 3 different options.

Cards are always drafted at level 1, and all cards from the game can be drafted, regardless whether the player owns them or not. This truly puts all players on a level-playing field.

The draws happen in that order:

[olist]
 3 legendary cards from different factions, resulting in a faction choice
 3 epic cards from your faction, resulting in an archetype choice
 3 rare cards with a mana cost of 3 - from faction + neutral
 3 rare cards with a mana cost of 4- from faction + neutral
 3 rare cards from faction + neutral
 3 rare cards from faction + neutral
 3 common cards with a mana cost of 3- from faction + neutral
 3 common cards with a mana cost of 4- from faction + neutral
 3 common cards from faction + neutral
 3 common cards from faction + neutral
 3 epic cards from faction + neutral
 3 legendary cards from the neutral faction
[/olist]
Note that for all rolls where the pool of cards is the current faction + the neutral faction, there will be at least one card from your faction, and at least one neutral card amongst the 3. This makes sure a roll doesn’t offer 3 neutral or 3 faction cards.

Leveling up cards
With every match, it is possible to refine the deck to make it more competitive. Regardless of the outcome of a match, it offers the ability to level up 3 cards from the deck.

Which cards can be upgraded is also drafted. That means each upgrade gets picked amongst 3 cards. There is also some logic to avoid the same card being upgraded on a loop while all other cards stay level 1. So all in all, the deck should improve somewhat uniformly throughout a session.

Replacing cards
Losing a match also provides the ability to replace a card from the deck. Because of the 3 loss limit, it is only possible to replace 2 cards in total.

Which card to replace is entirely up to the player, so any of the 12 cards can be discarded. In exchange, 3 level 1 cards from the same rarity get offered as options. This means replacing a leveled-up card will still yield a level 1 card.

FAQ

When is the update going to be released?
The balance changes will be deployed with the season reset as usual. The Draft mode will be released on December 20th — Merry Christmas!

Is it possible to abandon a draft session?
Not really. If you really want to give up on your current session, you can just lose matches until you’ve accumulated 3 losses. And if you don’t finish your session before the end of the event, it will be ended and you will be able to collect the rewards based on the amount of matches you won.

notes.title: Level Caps Update and Christmas Event
notes.notes:
Hello Stormbounders! A new version of Stormbound is coming early December bringing Level Caps, balance changes, a new card, some generous offers and various bonuses!

1. Disclaimer
2. Balance changes
3. New card
4. Card upgrading tutorial
5. Card level cap
6. Friendly battle notification
7. Christmas offers
8. Cheapened and special Brawl
9. FAQ

DISCLAIMER
The team is currently focusing most of its efforts onto the development of the upcoming Draft mode. We hope to be able to wrap it up in January!

We are also finalizing the new authentication system to let people sign in with their Google account or Apple ID. It will be possible to merge your Kongregate account to your new account (and vice versa). As a result, new players will no longer have to create a Kongregate account.


BALANCE CHANGES
This release, just like any other, will bring some balance changes.

Victors of the Melee’s strength is now 4/5/6/7/8 (up from 3/4/4/6/7).
Greenwood Ancients’ ability now grants 2/2/3/3/4 (up from 1/1/2/2/3).
Wetland Deceivers’ strength is now 3/4/5/6/7 (up from 3/4/4/5/6).
Scrapped Planners’ ability now sets strength back to 2/3/4/5/6 strength (down from 3/4/5/6/7).
Rain of Frogs now costs 2 mana at level 1 (down from 3) and its ability spawns 3 toads (down from 4).

As usual, some compensation in the form of coins and fusion stones will be provided to owners of Scrapped Planners, proportional to the level and rarity of the card.

NEW CARD
The day before Christmas (December 23rd), a new card will be released. It will join the few common cards with the ability to do chip damage!

MINION LAUNCHERS
Common, Rodent
4 Mana
0 Movement
4/5/6/7/8 Strength
On play, deal 1/2/2/3/3 damage to a random friendly non‑legendary unit on the side, then deal the same damage to the first enemy in front

As usual, there will be an exclusive pack to collect early copies of the new card. It will cost $9.99 and bring 10 copies of the card + 5 fusion stones + 750 coins. It will be available between December 23rd and January 1st.

CARD UPGRADING TUTORIAL
Upgrading card is essential to the Stormbound experience. However, it is not necessarily too obvious for new players how it works.

We are introducing a card upgrading tutorial for new players who have never upgraded any cards. The tutorial will guide them through the upgrading system and will make each player have a level 2 Gifted Recruits card at the end of it.

There is a second part of the tutorial that gives out 6 fusion stones, so players can decide themselves if they want to level up another common card right away or keep them for later.

CARD LEVEL CAP
A lot has been done to improve matchmaking over the last year, from algorithmic changes to base health caps. We are finally introducing a level cap based on the player’s league, the same way the fortress level cap works.

Starters League: Card level capped to 2
Iron League: Card level capped to 2
Bronze League: Card level capped to 2
Silver League: Card level capped to 3
Gold League: Card level capped to 3
Platinum League: Card level capped to 5
Diamond League: Card level capped to 5

FRIENDLY BATTLE NOTIFICATION

CHRISTMAS OFFERS
Like most holiday events, there will be some one-time only special offers for people willing to put some money into the game. The Christmas exclusive packs will be available from December 20th (9AM CET) until the end of the next Brawl!

Helpful Elf pack ($19.99): 20 rare cards + 15 epic cards + 10 legendary cards
Santa Edrik pack ($49.99): 6,500 coins + 650 rubies

And two new exclusive packs will be introduced!

Christmas pack ($19.99): 15 copies of Minion Launchers + a special avatar + 200 rubies + 10 fusion stones
Sapphire Bundle ($6.99): 1 book of Temples + 25 fusion stones. This one pack can be bought as many times as desired!

The special avatar from the Christmas Pack will be a Christmas Minion, which will be unavailable past the event. If you want it or desire to flaunt your swag in front of your friends, this is now or never!

CHEAPENED AND SPECIAL BRAWL

Something quite unique about this Brawl will be the introduction of a new modifier (in all difficulties). A 0-mana cost level 1 (unless owned and leveled) Minion Launchers card will be added to everyone’s deck (thus causing all decks to have 13 cards).

The balance changes will be deployed with the season reset as usual. The Christmas event itself (on which all the exclusive offers and bonuses are bound) will start on Christmas 20th and end with the next Brawl, on the following Sunday.

notes.title: October Update
notes.notes:
Hello Stormbounders! A new version of Stormbound is coming early October, bringing balance changes, new ancient cards, some generous offers and new Brawl modifiers!

Before we begin, let’s take a short moment to remember that the development team is currently quite fragmented due to well-deserved holidays in September, hence the releases being a little superficial. It will pick up some steam in October again to deliver new exciting content soon!

[olist]
 Balance changes
 New cards
 Cheapened Brawl
 Brawl modifiers
 Halloween event
 Vanishing packs bonus system
 New avatars
 FAQ
[/olist]

BALANCE CHANGES

This release, just like any other, will bring some balance changes.


 Lich Summoners’ spawn’s strength is now 3/4/5/6/7 (up from 3/3/4/5/6).
 Trekking Aldermen’s ability now deals 3/3/4/4/5 damage (up from 2/2/3/3/4).
 Razor-Sharp Lynxes’ strength-based ability is now +2 (up from +1).
 Snake Eyes’ ability now always draws 4 cards (up from 3 at level 1 to 3).
 Curse of Strings’ mana cost is now 6 (down from 7) and the strength threshold of its ability is now 7/9/11/14/17 (down from 8/10/12/15/18).
 Flaming Stream’s damage is now 4/5/6/7/8 (up from 3/4/5/6/7).


NEW CARDS
On October 4th, four new neutral ancient cards will be released, with some interesting mechanics that trigger before moving, like for Stoic Protectors. You can find some clarifications around the mechanics in the FAQ at the end of these release notes.

BOUNDED DAEMONS
Before moving, spawn a unit with x strength on both sides.

Mana: 4
Str: 1/2/2/3/4
Mov: 0/0/0/0/0
Ability: 2/2/3/3/4

b]LOST PSYCHES
Before moving, teleport itself to a random tile in its row

Mana: 3
Str: 2/3/4/5/6
Mov: 1/1/1/1/1

ERRATIC NEGLECTS
Before moving, get a random status effect.

Mana: 1
Str: 1/2/3/4/5/6
Mov: 0/0/0/0/0

FRAGMENTED ESSENCES
Before moving, split its strength equally into a unit on both sides. Cannot split again for this movement.

Mana: 2
Str: 3/4/5/6/7
Mov: 0/0/0/0/0

As usual, there will be 4 exclusive packs to collect early copies of the new Ancient cards. They all cost $9.99 and bring 5 copies of the given card + 750 coins. They will be available at the pace of one per week throughout October.

And if you would like some copies of all of the new Ancient cards and some fusion stones, you could consider the $19.99 exclusive pack granting 3 copies of each card + 10 fusion stones and 1,000 coins.

CHEAPENED BRAWL
Similar to previous events, the Brawl starting on October 28th (and only that one) is going to be cheaper. All fights will be 50% off. Owners of the Premium Pass will also have their usual discount applied, leading to a 60% reduction.

BRAWL MODIFIERS

There will be 4 new Brawl modifiers coming in October to keep things fresh. Most of the modifiers have been there for ages, and y’all know which decks to play in and out. We hope bringing more modifiers will keep the Brawl entertaining and rewarding!


 Reserve Management: any unused mana point is carried over to the next turn. There is no such thing as wasted mana anymore.
 Chaos Unleashed: units get a random status effect (silence, freeze, poison, confusion, or vitality) when played.
 Steady Growth: cards level up (up to level 5) when cycled. They can also be leveled up beyond the Casual/Warrior level cap!
 The Great Mill: playing any card instantly draws another one. Mana is the true limit.
 As soon as one of these new modifier shows up, it will be available in friendly mode so you can practice with your friends.

HALLOWEEN EVENT
To celebrate Halloween, there will be a small gift of 30 rubies for anyone logging into the game prior October 31st.

The Trick or Treat big bundle of sweets will also be available between October 4th and October 10th. It will yield 6 Mythic Tomes, 6 Heroic Tomes, and 6 Classic Tomes for $29.99.

In addition, all coins and rubies purchases in the shop will yield 20% extra resources between October 25th and November 14th. Might be a good time to put a few bucks into the game if you were considering it!

There will be some special weekly and monthly vanishing packs available throughout the month of November.

VANISHING PACKS BONUS SYSTEM
To make spending a few bucks here and there into vanishing packs more rewarding, we are introducing a system where every vanishing pack purchase grants you collectible points.


 Buying a daily vanishing pack yields 1 point.
 Buying a weekly vanishing pack yields 2 points.
 Buying a monthly vanishing pack yields 3 points.

These points are used to reach 3 different milestones which yield additional resources. Once the third milestone has been claimed, all 3 milestones will get reset in the next month so they can eventually be collected again.


 Milestone 1 requires 5 points and yields 1,000 coins.
 Milestone 2 requires 10 points in total (including the previous milestone) and yields 200 rubies.
 Milestone 3 requires 15 points in total (including the previous milestones) and yields 50 fusion stones.

As an example, if you collect 6 points in October, you get to collect the reward for the first milestone. When November comes, nothing will get reset: you will still have 6 points, and there will still be 2 milestones to reach. If in November you get 15 points in total, you’ll collect the remaining 2 milestones. Then in December, your points will get back to 0, and the milestones will be available for collection again once you have enough points.

An update made to vanishing packs is also that they are no longer limited to a single purchase for a given period (daily, weekly, monthly). That limit has been increased 3. So a vanishing pack can be bought 3 times per day/week/month.

NEW AVATARS
There will be three new premium avatars introduced in October, for 200 rubies a piece as usual. They are all somewhat gender-neutral: an officer, an elf and some sort of a druid.

FAQ

When is the update going to be released?
The balance changes will be deployed with the season reset as usual. The availability of packs will be spread throughout the month, one Ancient pack a week.

How does Fragmented Essences’ split work?
What happens depends on whether there is 0, 1 or 2 available cells on its sides:

If both side cells are available, Fragmented Essences split their strength (randomly if odd) into two copies, and then both move forward (but not split until next turn), leaving the center tile empty.
If only one side cell is available, Fragmented Essences splits half their strength (rounded down) there, and the copy moves forward (but not split until next turn).
If no side cell are available or Fragmented Essences have only 1 strength, nothing happens and they just move forward without splitting.
Note that the fragments are not tokens though—they also are Fragmented Essences. So they will also split and spawn before they move next.

Status effects such as poison and vitality are preserved on the fragments. So if the base unit is poisoned, fragments will also be poisoned.

Are Bounded Daemons another Dreadfauns?
Not really. Bounded Daemons will spawn every time it moves (or rather, just before) while Dreadfauns only spawns on play. Additionally, Bounded Daemons only spawns on lateral sides, not in front or in the back, so it can move right away.

Can Lost Psyches teleport on the tile they are already on?
No. Either there are available tiles on the row and they will teleport away, or all tiles are occupied and they will not attempt to teleport.
What qualifies as a status effect for Erratic Neglects?
Frozen, confused, vitalized, poisoned or silenced. Same list as for the new Chaos Unleashed Brawl modifier. Note that an already applied status effect cannot be rolled again. So if Erratic Neglects are already poisoned, they cannot roll poison again before moving—only the other status effects.

notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Hello Stormbounders! A new version of Stormbound is coming in early September, bringing balance changes, a new card, and a lot of generous offers to celebrate Stormbound’s 4th anniversary!

Before we begin, let’s take a short moment to remember that the development team is currently quite fragmented due to well-deserved holidays in August and September, hence the releases being a little superficial. It will pick up some steam in October to deliver new exciting content soon!

[olist]
 Balance changes
 New card
 Anniversary gifts
 Cheapened Brawl
 Exclusive offers
 Quality of life improvements
 FAQ
[/olist]
BALANCE CHANGES

This release, just like any other, will bring some balance changes.

 Stoic Protectors’ movement is now 1 (up from 0), strength is now 4/5/6/7/8 (up from 3/4/5/6/7) and their ability is now surrounding at all levels and triggers before moving instead of on play only.
 Chillbeards’ ability now grants 3/4/5/6/7 (down from 4/5/6/7/8) but is made to trigger when attacking a unit, regardless of position.
 Ludic Matriarchs’ ability now triggers when played bordering a friendly dragon, instead of only one bordering exactly 1 friendly dragon.
 Mechanical Workers’ strength is now 5/6/7/8/9 (up from 4/5/6/7/8).
 Rogue Sheep’s ability has been revamped to synergize with pirate cards in the hand of both players. The new ability at level 5 reads as such: “On the play, draw 3 single-use non-pirate card copies from the enemy’s hand. If you have a pirate card in hand, reduce their mana cost by 1.”
 
NERF COMPENSATION

As usual, some compensation in the form of coins and fusion stones will be provided to owners of Rogue Sheep, proportional to the level and rarity of the card. Find below the compensation values for each rarity and level.

Legendary card: 1 fusion stone at level 1, 20 coins and 5 fusion stones at level 2, 50 coins and 10 fusion stones at level 3, 150 coins and 20 fusion stones at level 4, 300 coins, and 50 fusion stones at level 5.


NEW CARD

A new card will be introduced on September 23rd: Sparkly Kitties. I am beyond humbled getting a card dedicated to me in the game, especially on the 4 years anniversary mark, almost 2.5 years to the day after I launched Stormbound-Kitty. Thank you to the team, and thank you to the incredible Stormbound community.

SPARKLY KITTIES:
On play, confuse itself then gain 2 speed.

Mana: 2
Str: 2/3/4/5/6
Movement: 0/0/0/0/0

The reason the card is marked as having 0 movements only to gain it on play is to avoid a confusing (no pun intended) movement tooltip in-game. If it had initial movement, the arrow would show moving forward twice, while this would not be the outcome.

Last but not least, all books will contain more cards between September 17th and September 20th. Books normally holding 3 cards will contain 4, and books usually containing 6 cards (Mythic, Heroic, and Classic) will yield 8!

CHEAPENED BRAWL

Similar to previous events, the Brawl starting on September 16th (and only that one) is going to be cheaper. All fights will be 50% off. Owners of the Premium Pass will also have their usual discount applied, leading to a 60% reduction.

For those of you willing to put a few bucks into the game and supporting the creators, this anniversary event will introduce 4 special in-app purchases. They will all be available for a week from September 13th.

 1 Mythic Tome
 100 coins


The $19.99 pack will yield:

 4 Mythic Tomes
 4 Heroic Tomes
 500 coins


The $49.99 pack will yield:

 10 Mythic Tomes
 10 Heroic Tomes
 10 Classic Tomes
 1,500 coins


The $99.99 pack will yield:

 20 Mythic Tomes
 20 Heroic Tomes
 20 Classic Tomes
 5,000 coins

BALANCE CHANGES

This release, like any other, brings some balance changes.

 Temple of Life’s ability now considers all friendly units (instead of surrounding only), but affects less units at all levels (from 2/3/4/5/6 to 1/2/2/3/3). It also attempts to spawn a 1-strength copy of itself on the tile behind, like a tree expanding its roots. Additionally, its strength has been decreased by 1 (from 3/4/5/6/7 to 2/3/4/5/6).
 Temple of the Mind’s ability still triggers at the start of the turn but now grants (or removes if already present) fixedly forward movement to the leftmost unit in the hand, then destroys the weakest confused unit on the board.
 Queen of Herds’ strength is now 8/10/12/12/14 (up from 6/8/10/10/12).
 Blood Ministers’ strength is now 5/6/7/8/10 (up from 3/4/5/6/8).
 Rogue Sheepnow costs 4 mana (down from 6) and its strength is now 3/4/5/6/7 (up from 2/3/4/5/7). Additionally, its ability is reworked from scratch. It now draws up to 1/1/2/2/3 card copies from the enemy’s hand, and reduces the mana cost of these copies by 1. Card copies can be cycled like normal cards but they are single-use. They do not go back into the deck once they’ve been played once.

Quite uniquely, Rogue Sheep owners will be compensated with the usual rewards despite the card being reworked and overall buffed. We decided to do so because you’re effectively “losing” a card you might have invested your resources in.

As usual, some compensation in the form of coins and fusion stones will be provided to owners of Rogue Sheep, proportional to the level and rarity of the card. Find below the compensation values for each rarity and level.

Legendary card: 1 fusion stone at level 1, 20 coins and 5 fusion stones at level 2, 50 coins and 10 fusion stones at level 3, 150 coins and 20 fusion stones at level 4, 300 coins and 50 fusion stones at level 5.

TEMPLE OF TIME:
At the end of your turn, remember the state of surrounding friendly units and structures. At the start of your turn, restore X of them to that state.

Mana: 3
Str: 2/3/4/5/6
Ability: 1/2/2/3/3

 1 random legendary card, 500 coins, 100 rubies, 50 fusion stones - It will be available between July 29th and August 1st.

BRAWL BONUSES

The second part of the new heart system will be introduced in late July in the form of Brawl winning bonuses.

The idea is that after every victory in Brawl, the player will be offered one of two random bonuses, amongst a set of 9 different possible bonuses (see the complete list below). Some of them will provide resources while some will improve the player’s livelihood in Brawl by redeeming and refilling hearts.

A player begins a Brawl adventure in the selected tier with 3 full green hearts (just like it is right now). When losing a match, a player loses one heart (it gets emptied and red). If all hearts are lost, then the player’s crowns get reset to the beginning of the current milestone.

Here is the breakdown of every victory bonus:


 Fortress Up bonus: Picking this bonus will increase the Fortress Level of the player by 1 within the current Brawl difficulty and only for Brawl matches. It will not increase the Fortress Level beyond the cap for that Brawl. This bonus cannot be drawn if already capped.
 Life/Lives Up bonuses: Picking these bonuses will refill a heart (or all hearts), giving the player extra chances to climb the milestones without being reset to the start of the current milestone.
 Rusty Slot: Picking this bonus will grant the player an extra heart slot (up to 5 heart slots in total). Once the player loses a life from this slot, the slots destroys itself. It also destroys itself on milestone reset.
 Solidify: Picking this bonus will make one of the player’s Rusty slots hearts indestructible. From there on, it behaves like one of three default slots.
 Ice Armor: Picking this bonus will give an Ice Armor to the first full heart. After a loss, the Ice Armor gets destroyed while keeping the heart beneath it intact.
 Resources bonuses: Picking these bonuses will immediately grant the player a certain amount of resources, varying based on the Brawl difficulty and milestone.

 The Coins bonus can be obtained from the very first milestone. Its rewards can go up to 100 coins in Casual, 250 coins in Warrior and coin coins in Ultimate.
 The Rubies bonus can be obtained from milestone 3 onwards and can go up to 25 rubies in Casual, 50 rubies in Warrior and 100 rubies in Ultimate.
 The Fusion Stones can be obtained from milestone 5 onwards and bonus can go up to 3 fusion stones in Casual, 10 fusion stones in Warrior and 25 fusion stones in Ultimate.


CHEAPENED BRAWL

Similar to previous events, the Brawl starting on July 29th (and only that one) is going to be cheaper. All fights will be 10% off. Owners of the Premium Pass will also have their usual discount applied, leading to a 20% reduction.

Additionally, to apologize for the recent sub-par experience with the Brawl, every player logging at least once into the game before the end of 29th of July will be rewarded with 500 coins.

Four new books will be introduced, all available to buy with rubies as usual. We hope they help players sharpening their collection!

 The new Book of Structures costs 40 rubies and contains 3 structures with rarity odds being 50/30/15/5.

We hope this will help players with a more sporadic involvement with the game to still get all the rewards they need to progress.

notes.title: Brawls Update
notes.notes:
The purpose of remaking the known Brawl mode is to give players the opportunity to participate in it at any time during their Stormbound progression. This creative game mode should appeal to both advanced players and people just starting their adventure with Stormbound.

Up until now, the Brawl mode has very much been intended as end-game content for players with very advanced collections. Others had nothing to look for in this mode because the advantage of one over the other excluded the possibility of any fair competition.


THREE DIFFICULTIES

From now on, there will be 3 running Brawl events per week, of three different difficulties: Casual, Warrior and Ultimate. The current Brawl version would sit somewhere between Warrior and Ultimate.

Additionally, every match will have a Fortress Level cap, a card level cap, and a limited number of turns, which can therefore result in a draw. This is intended to make matches more fair by eliminating a lot of the differences in base health and cards between players.

The crossed diamonds in the joint screenshot are further explained in the Crowns & milestones section.

Casual
The Casual Brawl unlocks at Fortress Level 11. In this Brawl event, the Fortress Level is limited to 12, the cards’ level is fixed to level 1, and matches last up to 10 turns per player.

Warrior
The Warrior Brawl unlocks at Fortress Level 12. In this Brawl event, the Fortress Level is limited to 14, the cards’ level is capped to 3 and matches last up to 15 turns per player.

Ultimate
The Ultimate Brawl unlocks at Fortress Level 14. In this Brawl event, the Fortress Level and cards are not capped, and matches last up to 20 turns per player.


CROWNS & MILESTONES

Victories will still yield 5 crowns and losses will still yield 1 crown. However, due to the fact that matches are limited in length, draws can happen and will reward 2 crowns to each player. A draw occurs when both players have the same amount of health by the end of the last turn.

To avoid making the Brawl too easy for lower tiers and difficulty levels, every milestone needs to be reached without losing more than 2 times. After 3 losses across a given milestone, the crowns will be reset to the previously reached milestone. For instance, if losing 3 times between 50 crowns and 70 crowns, the crowns will be reset to 50 crowns.

We are be keeping a very close eye on this system as the goal is not to make Brawl frustrating. Additionally, we are looking for ways to make losses redeemable in the near future so it’s a little more fluctuating than just 3 losses per milestone.


FAQ

What will happen to the current Brawl?

The current unique Brawl will no longer exist. It will always be 3 Brawl events per week, one for each difficulty.

How long will each Brawl last?

The Brawl events will still last from Thursday to Sunday—nothing changes in that regard. That being said, we are considering changing this in future patches.

What will happen to the Brawl leaderboard?

Each Brawl event will have its own weekly leaderboard, but besides that, it will stay the same.

Will there ever be new modifiers?

Yes, we are working on bringing new modifiers to the Brawl to keep it fresh.

notes.title: Friendly Matches Update
notes.notes:
Hello Stormbound! We are here to present you long awaited Friendly Matches Update.

It'll contain:

New Friendly Matches System where you can choose:

- Card Level Cap
- Base HP Cap
- Starting Mana
- Turns per Player
- Custom rules (Brawl rules)

New Feline Card - SLYBOOTS,
Rare Common, 4 Mana, 1 Movement
4/5/6/7/8 Strength
Ability: On play confuse up to 1/1/2/2/3 bordering enemy units

New Feline Card (available from 15.10.2020) - EXCITED MOUSER
Rare Common, 5 Mana, 0 movement
5/6/7/9/11 Strength
Ability: On play confuse the same number of surrounding enemies, as there are surrounding friendly units.

New ANCIENT Card - Bisanu (available from around 2 weeks after Excited Mouser
Stats and ability are for now a secret.


Social Panel
It features Discord, Reddit, Stormbound-Kitty, the Stormbound Wiki page and social media networks (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram)

Connecting with Stormbound on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram will grant 10 rubies for each.


Balance Changes

- Doctor Mia's ability now affects surrounding structures at level 2 instead of bordering only
- Scrapped Planners' strength is now 4/5/6/7/8 (from 3/4/5/6/7), but their ability remains the same
- Booming Professors no longer have initial movement (down from 1)
- Siegebreakers now have 1 movement (up from 0), and their ability affect surrounding structures instead of bordering only
- Voidsurgers' ability now triggers when having at least 2 surrounding enemies instead of bordering only
- Kindred's Grace now grants more strength to the main target (from 5/6/6/8/10) to 6/7/7/9/11
- Avian Stalkers' mana cost is now 6 (down from 7)
- Hair-Raising Cat's ability now triggers for a surrounding enemy instead of bordering only
- Bigthrust Tigers' mana cost is now 2 (down from 3) but their strength is now 1/2/3/4/5 (down from 3/4/5/6/7)
- Laurus, King in Exile's ability strength limit is increased by 1 (from 3/4/5/6/7 to 4/5/6/7/8)
- Dark Harvest now affects enemy surrounding a friendly unit instead of bordering only
- Toxic's Sacrifice's mana cost is now 2 (up from 1) but deals one more damage (from 1/2/3/4/5 to 2/3/4/5/6).

Vanishing Packs 

For those of you who are not against putting real money in the game every now and then, you will be pleased to know, that there are now many more packs.

Every day, every week, and every month (client local time 9AM), you will be offered one random resource pack and one random card pack. 

All daily packs cost $1.99, all weekly packs cost $9.99 and all monthly packs cost $29.99. These packs can be bought once per period.

Minor UI improvements and bug fixes

notes.title: September Balance changes
notes.notes:
Hello Stormbound!

We don't want you to get bored with the meta, thus why, we've decided to welcome the new season with a few balance changes (more coming soon, in a big update). 


Patch info:


NEUTRAL
Emerald Towers now have 4/5/5/6/7 strength (instead of 3/4/4/5/6).

Bladestorm’s ability now deals 1/2/2-3/3/4 damage (instead of 1/1-2/2/2-3/3), making it more compelling at level 5.

Flooding the Gates now costs 4 mana (instead of 5). It is unclear whether that will increase the popularity of this card at all however.

Unhealthy Hysteria now costs 3 mana (instead of 2) and its ability now targets a unit with at most 4/5/6/7/8 strength.

Hunter’s Vengeance now costs 2 mana at every level (instead of 3 at level 1 to 3) and its ability now deals 2/3/4/5/6 damage (instead of 2/3/4/4/5 damage).

Crazy Bombers now cost 8 mana (instead of 9) and their strength now is 6/7/9/11/13. This might mean this card gets to be used outside of mana ramp decks.

Harvesters of Souls now cost 5 mana (instead of 6). Hopefully a way to make this interesting community-designed card more prominent in the meta.

Terrific Slayers now have 2/3/4/5/6 strength (instead of 1/2/3/4/5).

Dangerous Suitors now cost 6 mana (instead of 7) and has 4/5/6/8/10 strength (instead of 5/7/7/10/10).



IRONCLAD
Unstable Build now has 5/6/7/8/9 strength (instead of 4/5/6/7/8), which essentially grants it an extra turn at levels 1, 3 and 5 (provided it does not receive other damage).

Fortification Tonic now costs 2 mana at every level (instead of 3 at level 1 to 3) and its ability now grants 2/3/4/5/6 strength (instead of 2/3/4/4/5).



WINTER
Underground Spring now has 4/5/7/8/10 strength (instead of 4/5/6/7/8), and its ability is 1/1-2/1-2/2/2 (instead of 1 at every level).

notes.title: Sheepyard's First Update
notes.notes:
Hello Stormbound! Here we are to present you changes that are mostly already implemented in game, today we're adding some additional tweaks, that are also included on the list below.



Economy Update

QUESTS:

- Tier 1 quests will now grant 100 coins
- Tier 2 quests will now grant 5 rubies
- Tier 3 quests will now grant 150 coins or 2 fusion stones, depending on the quest.

Each quest can still be rerolled once per day, but a tier 1 quest will always grant coins, a tier 2 quest will always grant rubies and a tier 3 quest will either grant coins (6 out of 10 quests) or fusion stones (4 out of 10 quests).

DAILY COIN CAP:

- Coin cap has been increased to coin 400 coins (up from coin 250 coins).



New Legendary Card

ROGUE SHEEP:

7 Mana, 2/3/4/5/7 Base Strength (level 1 - level 5), Movement = 0

Level 1: On death, deal 1 damage to all enemy units and structures. Add 0-1 damage for up to 1 Pirate in hand
Level 2: On death, deal 1 damage to all enemy units and structures. Add 1 damage for up to 2 Pirates in hand
Level 3: On death, deal 2 damage to all enemy units and structures. Add 1 damage for up to 2 Pirates in hand
Level 4: On death, deal 2 damage to all enemy units and structures. Add 1 damage for up to 3 Pirates in hand
Level 5: On death, deal 2 damage to all enemy units and structures. Add 2 damage for up to 3 Pirate in hand 



Balance Changes 

- Aged Duskbringers have their strength and ability both decreased by 1 at all levels.
- Beards of Crowglyph cost 6 mana at all levels (up from 5).
- Prime Oracle Bragda has its strength decreased by 1 at all levels.
- Blood Ministers have their strength decreased by 2 at all levels.
- Hairy Chestnuts have their strength decreased by 2 at all levels.
- Herald’s Hymn costs 7 mana at all levels (up from 6).
- Queen of Herds costs 7 mana at all levels (up from 6). Additionally, its ability is no longer able to play 
   a card of rarity higher than rare.
- Bucks of Wasteland have their strength decreased by 1 at all levels.
- Frozen Core has its ability decreased by 1 at all levels.
- Rockworkers have their movement decreased by 1 at all levels.
- Gift of the Wise costs 8 mana at all levels (up from 7) and grants one more mana at all levels.
- Earthfathers have their strength decreased by 1 at all levels and regenerate 3, 3, 3 (down from 4), 4 
  (down from 5), 4 (down from 6).
- Confinement costs 3 mana at all levels (down from 4 at level 1 to 3) and reduce strength to 5, 4, 3, 2 
   (down from 3) and 1.
- Execution does 1 more damage at all levels.
- Fluffy Badboxers cost 5 mana at all levels (down from 6).



Mechanic Changes

CONFUSION's new effect:

If confused, a unit has ⅓ chance to move forward, ⅓ chance to move inwards and ⅓ chance to move outwards. If sitting on the edge of the board, the unit has ⅓ chance to move forward and ⅔ chance to move inwards.



Matchmaking Tweaks

We're introducing a base health upper limit based on the current league a player is in. The caps go as follow:

- Diamond: no cap (besides 20 maximum health).
- Platinum: health capped at 17.
- Gold: health capped at 14.
- Silver: health capped at 12.
- Bronze: health capped at 11.
- Iron: health capped at 10.



A lot of UI Improvements and bug fixes

notes.title: The Brawl update is out!
notes.notes:
A new game mode Brawl has arrived! Every week there is a new theme which boosts the stats of a set of cards, challenging you to build specialized decks. Win matches to earn crowns that will unlock powerful rewards.

The Elders are added as the newest race in Stormbound. These 13 units will be introduced one at a time until the end of the year. The Elders are the veterans of their armies and know how to survive battles. They have a unique trigger that allows them to do their special ability after surviving damage.

Also in this update:
- Balanced cards
- Revamped the content of the card books
- Excess cards are converted into coins
- Updated main menu
- Improved interface flow
